def: NVIDIA's data-center GPU architecture announced in 2022, behind the H100 and H200, which added FP8 tensor cores and fourth-generation NVLink at up to 900 GB/s per GPU.
practice: Still a common baseline in serving benchmarks such as MLPerf Inference and in cloud pricing as of November 2026; the H200 raises memory to 141 GB of HBM3e from the H100's 80 GB.
